question_text:
Which sentence corrects the double negative in this Makati City grievance response?

"The employee claimed that he didn't receive no training on the new system."

A. The employee claimed that he didn't receive any training on the new system.
B. The employee claimed that he didn't receive no training on the new system.
C. The employee claimed that he received no training on the new system.
D. The employee claimed that he didn't receive training on the new system.

options.text: The employee claimed that he didn't receive any training on the new system.
The employee claimed that he didn't receive no training on the new system.
The employee claimed that he received no training on the new system.
The employee claimed that he didn't receive training on the new system.
